properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:00PM EDT until August 9 at 4:45PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description: At 400 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Canton, moving east at 35 mph. HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
properties.instruction: For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a building.

properties.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued January 15 at 6:00AM EST until January 16 at 12:00PM EST by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description: Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 4 to 8 inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph. Travel could be very difficult to impossible.
properties.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions can be obtained by calling 511.
